  A chapter whose marks are all in its front matter and whose extension is not

# An .Rmd chapter marking only in its front matter

The body of this chapter marks nothing at all, so every term it contributes
comes from the front matter above — written in a field other than `abstract:`,
into an index other than the first, and under an entry the visible words do not
spell.
